newsitem.title: UK: Transport to buy-back 9.8 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: Transport to buy-back 9.8 pct of shares.

text.p: Transport Development Group Plc said on Thursday it had instructed its brokers, Merrill Lynch, to buy up to 14.5 million shares (9.8 percent of its issued ordinary share capital) at a price of 180p.

The plant and vehicle hire firm said that if the maximum number of shares were bought, its gearing would rise to 17 percent from the current five percent. It said it would fund the share buy-back from existing bank facilities.
It also plans to increase its UK truck leasing programme and expects that during 1997 it will lease up to half of its annual requirements with a capital value of 15 million stg.
"These two earnings-enhancing financing decisions do not affect the board's strategy to remain as a major player in the logistics and hire industries," chief executive Alan Cole said in a statement.
By 0955 GMT, shares in the company had risen eight pence to stand at 176-1/2.
